title: When mercy feels hard to receive after the mind has slipped
issueStatement: The heart keeps assuming kindness must first be earned. The problem now is not only temptation or pain, but what to do after the slip has already happened.
centralInsight: Guru keeps mercy close to gift, nearness, and return. Gurbani keeps repair close to remembrance, humility, and return instead of theatre.
practicalReflection: Receive the day as given, then answer it with Naam. Receive one line as mercy before turning it into a performance review.
actionPrompt: Receive one line as mercy before turning it into a performance review. Choose the next truthful return instead of rehearsing the failure.
